title: nassella airoides
intro: Nassella airoides, commonly known as airoid needle grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Nassella airoides include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial agent, and anti-edematous agent, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
